desc: Parse input and build the `a` matrix (1 for A, 0 for B).
Verify that every row and every column has an even number of A's (XOR of `a` is 0). If not, output 0.
Compute prefix XORs `P[i][j]` for rows and `Q[j][i]` for columns.
Initialize a DSU with parity for `H+W` nodes (rows and columns).
For each B cell, add the equation `x_i XOR y_j = 1 XOR P[i][j] XOR Q[j][i]` to the DSU.
If any contradiction occurs, output 0. Otherwise, count connected components `C` and output `2^C mod 998244353`.
